examples.subject: Mobile mapping route planning
examples.body:
Hi Nathan,

I wanted to add a bit more context on why I reached out. Since May, part of my co-op has involved working directly with teams at Anthropic and NVIDIA to deploy their biological research workflows onto robotic lab hardware. My work is on the general planning and search layer underneath that, figuring out how to execute new workflows without deadlocks, resource conflicts or other edge cases that can cause a run to fail, then using digital twins to simulate the outcome before anything touches the hardware.

Being this close to frontier AI and biological research has also made me think a lot about where I want to put my own time. A lot of the push in medicine and longevity seems likely to benefit the ultra wealthy first, while countries like Sierra Leone are still losing people to diseases like tuberculosis that we already know how to treat. Partly for my own morality, I want to offset some of that by applying my ML and planning work to problems with a clearer benefit to society.

That is a big part of why Aclima stood out to me. Better street-level pollution data can help cities see where people are actually being exposed and act on it, and the routing side maps well to the planning work I already do.

If there is a technical problem on your side that could fit into a 4–6 week paid contract, I'd be very interested in taking ownership of it. The routing simulation idea was one thought, but I'd much rather work on something the ML team already wants solved. I work pretty intensely and am used to getting unfamiliar problems to something concrete quickly.

Happy to hop on a call if anything comes to mind.

Best,
Andrew

patterns.opening: Work explained as a causal sequence, not a credential list.
patterns.motivation: Personal concern follows directly from proximity to the work.
patterns.bridge: One paragraph names an everyday consequence and connects the relevant skill.
patterns.commercial_ask: Conditional 4–6 week paid contract, original idea treated as provisional, team need takes precedence.
patterns.ending: Ownership and execution pace, then a natural invitation. No question mark required.
patterns.absent: No CEO-proximity claim, forced backlog question, 15-minute CTA, guarantee or separate resume ask.
